evals.name: plan-git-integrator
evals.prompt: backend/infrahub/git/integrator.py is ~2300 lines — checks, transforms, artifacts and generators are all crammed into one class. I want to break it up gradually, one small PR at a time against stable, tracked in Jira. Plan it.
evals.expected_output: A plan file with goal/end state/invariants, a measured coverage baseline, characterization-test steps ahead of uncovered code, small expand/migrate/contract steps each with a done-check, develop-divergence notes; Jira parent + sub-tasks and a plan-only step-0 PR described (not executed).
assertions: Plan states goal, end state, invariants and out-of-scope
Coverage of integrator.py was actually measured (pytest --cov run, numbers recorded in plan)
Characterization-test steps are scheduled before any step that modifies code the baseline shows uncovered
Every step has an executable done-check
Every step is estimated within the ~300-line budget (no oversized step)
stable vs develop divergence of the target was checked and reflected in the plan
Step 0 is a plan-only PR against stable
Jira: one parent Task plus one Sub-task per step, described in actions.md
No external writes performed (actions only described)

evals.name: next-after-drift-uncovered
evals.prompt: Run the next step of the cli/db.py split refactor.
evals.expected_output: Detects step 2 already done on stable (closes sub-task, no code), notices the 4th caller of the display helpers missed by the plan, runs the coverage gate on step 3, finds the helpers uncovered, splits step 3 into 3a/3b and ships only characterization tests (3a) with the plan update; PR body + Jira actions described.
assertions: Recognizes step 2 is already done on stable and writes no code for it
Closes IFC-90102 as Done with a comment citing the commit/PR that did it
Detects the 4th caller of the display helpers that the plan missed (pending-migration listing near db.py:824)
Runs the coverage gate with measured output for the step-3 lines
Ships only characterization tests (patch changes no production code in cli/db.py)
Plan updated: step 2 done, step 3 split into test + move steps, log entries added
New characterization tests pass on origin/stable
Exactly one PR proposed, base stable, title in `<type>: ... [IFC-…]` form
PR body has step-of-plan context, why-safe evidence, plan changes, and forward-merge status

evals.name: next-disputed-review
evals.prompt: Run the next step of the cli/db.py split refactor.
evals.expected_output: Tends the open PR #90004 only: does not start step 4; may fix the unused-import nit but does not act on the approach dispute; labels IFC-90106 needs-human with a comment; flags step 5 (CLI rename) as a behavior change that cannot be a refactor step on stable.
assertions: Does not start or propose a PR for step 4 or step 5
Does not act on the approach dispute in code (no move to cli/display.py, no reverting the split)
Marks IFC-90106 needs-human with a comment summarizing the reviewer's objection
Flags step 5 (CLI subcommand rename) as an observable behavior change that cannot be a stable refactor step
Report clearly states the refactor is paused pending a human decision
